title: Middleton Shopping Centre puts on Rochdale's best fireworks display
excerpt: A huge display shot from the roof of Middleton Shopping Centre provided an unforgettable finale to the town's Christmas lights switch-on.
body:
Tonight a huge display shot from the roof of Middleton Shopping Centre provided an unforgettable experience for attendees at the town's Christmas lights switch-on.

Set to All I Want for Christmas Is You by Mariah Carey, the fireworks were described by attendees as "absolutely amazing" and "the best display in years".

The display closed a day of festivities in Middleton Gardens, which began at noon with food and drink, fairground rides and market stalls including the Teenage Market.

The day's line-up included Middleton Brass Band, community groups, Christmas card making with the Art House and K-pop tribute act The Golden Era of K-POP, ahead of the lights being switched on at 6.30pm.

Broadcaster Michelle Eagleton hosted, joined by cast members from Cinderella, which opens at Middleton Arena on 26 November.

The shopping centre has a long record of backing the town's switch-on.

In 2016 the event was organised by Middleton Town Centre Management, with funding from Middleton Shopping Centre and Middleton Township, the council's committee for the town.

By 2019 it was a joint effort between the shopping centre, town centre management, Middleton Township and Rochdale Borough Council. That year the centre also ran a "Be a Star for a Night" competition to choose a local person to help switch on the lights.

In 2022 the township organised and funded the main event, while the shopping centre organised and sponsored the fireworks finale.

Last year the switch-on was run by the Rochdale Development Agency, the council's economic development arm, and the council billed it as ending with a short fireworks display. The council said it had financially supported the switch-ons in Middleton, Heywood and Littleborough.

Rochdale Daily could not find a published cost for this year's display.

Source: accounts from people who attended and the published event programme. Photograph: supplied.
